mapper.select: select id, company_no as no, company_name as name from reim_company where #{keyword} is null or #{keyword} = '' or company_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or company_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by company_no

select id, department_no as no, department_name as name from reim_department where #{keyword} is null or #{keyword} = '' or department_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or department_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by department_no

select id as reimburserId, employee_no as reimburserNo, employee_name as reimburserName from employee where #{keyword} is null or #{keyword} = '' or employee_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or employee_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by employee_no

select id as businessTypeId, business_type_no as businessTypeNo, business_type_name as businessTypeName, there_subordinate_node as thereSubordinateNode, superior_id as superiorId from business_type where #{superiorId} is null or #{superiorId} = '' or superior_id = #{superiorId} order by business_type_no

select city_no as cityNo, city_name as cityName, city_type as cityType from city where #{keyword} is null or #{keyword} = '' or city_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or city_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by city_no

select id as projectId, project_no as projectNo, project_name as projectName from project where #{keyword} is null or #{keyword} = '' or project_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or project_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by project_no
select city_type from city where city_no = #{cityNo} limit 1
